sql_template:
-- Minimum group size, one query at a time, on a synthetic customer table the
-- author loads. Not a measurement of Snowflake or BigQuery until it is run there.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(c_acctbal) AS total
FROM customer
WHERE c_nationkey = :nation AND c_mktsegment = :segment
HAVING COUNT(*) >= :k;
estimated_cost_usd: under a dollar on an X-Small warehouse or 10 GB of BigQuery on-demand if the table is the 1,500-row synthetic customer table and each k runs a few dozen queries; confirm the price sheet before running.
